verdict.meaning: corrected flagship-six harness executed against production and captured product failures

actual_results.test: hero observatory samples only browser-local telemetry and exposes bounded honest state
hero observatory reports unavailable honestly when requestAnimationFrame is absent at sampling time
actual_results.failure: getByTestId('hero-observatory') element not found/visible after normal hydration

actual_results.test: about compass keeps the ten source answers server-rendered and selectable by named buttons
experience explorer exposes a named range scrubber with sourced duration geometry and no score
skills trace keeps the certificate table SSR-readable and changes exact capability evidence
vitrine mechanism diagrams are six unique sourced schematics with inspectable details and existing exclusions
actual_results.failure: mechanism-diagram count was 0 instead of expected 6

actual_results.test: listen resonance tracks focus across existing contact anchors without forms, autoplay audio, or obstruction
no-JavaScript SSR preserves the six section facts, first CTA, role bullets, and vitrine schematics
actual_results.failure: SSR did not contain Vitrine mechanism schematic text from mechanismFacts

actual_results.test: reduced motion at 320px preserves meaningful text and horizontal bounds

harness_corrections: SSR text assertions decode HTML entities before comparing raw strings.
Range input mutation now uses the native HTMLInputElement value setter before input/change events so React sees the change.
Listen obstruction checks scroll each anchor into the viewport before elementFromPoint sampling.
requestAnimationFrame unavailability is isolated after normal hydration and restored in finally/page leave instead of deleting rAF before page load.
Added no-JavaScript SSR semantic coverage for all six sections, first CTA, all role bullets, and Vitrine schematic facts.
320px reduced-motion check measures actual visible text rectangles within the viewport rather than document width alone.
notes: No product/source fixes were made. red.log was not modified.
